title: By whatever means
explanation: The expression describes pursuing a result by every available means. Depending on context, it can suggest determination or a willingness to use unfair methods.
meaning_odia: ଯେକୌଣସି ଉପାୟରେ କାମ ହାସଲ କରିବା। ପରିସ୍ଥିତି ଅନୁସାରେ ଏଥିରେ ଚେଷ୍ଟାର ଦୃଢ଼ତା ବା ଅନ୍ୟାୟ ଉପାୟର ଇଙ୍ଗିତ ରହିପାରେ।
usage_example: A character in a story resolves to win the contest by persuasion, pressure or a clever plan. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: This is an adverbial idiom in the dictionary, not a complete narrative proverb or an endorsement of deceit.
